t: These Site Mudguard safety dealer boots are engineered for demanding work environments, offering essential foot protection for trade professionals. Featuring a 200 Joule steel toe cap and a steel penetration-resistant midsole, these sturdy work boots safeguard feet from impacts and sharp objects such as nails. The shock-absorbing sole and reinforced heel provide comfort and support during long shifts, making them ideal for construction site workers and warehouse operatives. Crafted from durable leather with a wide fit and convenient slip-on design, these brown work boots combine practicality with vital safety, including an oil-repellent sole, ensuring reliable performance across various challenging trade settings.
